title: AIR
tagline: AIR is an AI-powered chatbot that helps you optimise your wetware.
description:
AIR is a next-generation AI-powered chatbot designed as a tool for transformation, made for anyone seeking to optimise their daily state. 

Built on n8n workflows and OpenAI’s LLM, AIR stands out for its unique blend of science-backed routines, playful personality, and deep personalisation. The bots mission is to help users reduce stress, build healthier habits, and operate at their best, all whilst appreciating the madness of the human condition.

It engages users through a minimalist, orb-centric web interface that encourages regular check-ins and guided sessions such as breathwork and meditation. AIR is infused with a distinctive personality, making each interaction both effective and engaging.

As users interact, the AI learns their preferences, communication style, and emotional states, allowing for increasingly personalised and empathetic support. 

AIR’s integration with blockchain technology brings a new level of accountability and community to personal expansion. Each session, challenge, or check-in can be validated and recorded on-chain, allowing users to prove participation, track progress, and even compete or collaborate with friends and colleagues. 

This system supports gamified daily challenges, where users are prompted to complete three-minute micro-habits, with their achievements transparently logged and verifiable. Over time, this creates a loyalty and rewards ecosystem, where consistent engagement can be redeemed for perks.

Security and privacy are ensured through integrations with Privy for authentication.

AIR is a science-driven, blockchain-empowered, and community-oriented tool for personal transformation. By combining AI, playful design, and verifiable progress, AIR aims to redefine how we approach daily checkins and productivity, helping users everywhere to optimise their wetware and thrive.
how_its_made: The air agent is built using a multi agent system that is built in n8n, combines Open Ai with subagents. We used the multi agent framework to have one agent with access to a number of tools, such as the breathwork agent and the GM agent. For the front end, we used nextjs with Privy wallet. We deployed on Hedera and Flow. For the storage we used Walrus to save the personalised recordings.
